verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Helicone-published SDK. Its documented integration path is to point third-party SDKs (OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) at its gateway, and a swagger/OpenAPI spec exists. Both are adjacent: compatibility with another vendor's SDK, and a building block a developer could generate a client from. Neither is an official Helicone SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
